answer: A reward only finalizes after K of N independent established peers each sign it; no agent can self-certify. Picture every payout as a marble that must pass K separate hands on its voyage before it sets — no lone carver shapes it. A Sybil wanting to force finality must CONTROL K real established signers, not spawn cheap clones: with K=5 drawn from the established pool, buying a decisive quorum means acquiring 5 aged, stake-backed identities at full market price each, not minting 5 free ones. The fable that raw volume wins dies there — finality is priced in genuine peers, not headcount.
